lcc_original: 上帝造了穹蒼，將穹蒼以下的水和穹蒼以上的水分開：就這樣成了。
notes: UNV 空氣 → LCC 穹蒼: different translation of H7549 (raqia); both mean firmament/expanse
UNV 分開了 → LCC 分開: LCC omits aspect particle 了; H0914+WTH8686 attach to 分開
UNV 事就這樣 → LCC 就這樣: LCC drops 事; H3651 attaches to 就這樣
LCC 和 (between the two water clauses) left unannotated — replaces UNV enumeration comma 、; the waw conjunction is absorbed into the WAH prefix of the second H0996 (beyn)
{<WAH0853>} and {<WH0834>} remain implicit — LCC also has no explicit words for the direct object marker or the second relative pronoun
